```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")

seurat_integrated <- readRDS("results/Analysis_V1/integrated_seurat_Resolution.rds")
```
get all the refrence datasets that you can use to map the cells 
```{r}
#remotes::install_github("rnabioco/clustifyrdata")
library(clustifyrdata)
#https://github.com/rnabioco/clustifyrdatahub

#####use the  Mouse Cell Atlas
seurat_integrated <- clustify(
  input = seurat_integrated,
  cluster_col = "integrated_snn_res.2.2",
  ref_mat = ref_MCA,
  seurat_out = TRUE
)

metadata <- seurat_integrated@meta.data


# calculate correlation
d <- as.data.frame(table(metadata$type, metadata$integrated_snn_res.2.2))

#ref_MCA

names(d) <- c("ref_MCA", "cluster2.2", "n")

d

```
```{r}

res <- clustify(
  input = seurat_integrated,
  metadata = seurat_integrated$type,
  ref_mat = ref_MCA
)

plot_best_call(
  cor_mat = res,
  metadata = pbmc_meta,
  cluster_col = "classified"
)


library(clustifyrdata)
#Mouse RNA-seq from 28 cell types

seurat_integrated <- clustify(
  input = seurat_integrated,
  cluster_col = "integrated_snn_res.2.2",
  ref_mat = ref_mouse.rnaseq,
  seurat_out = TRUE
)
#names(metadata)[names(metadata)=="type.clustify"] <- "clustiyr.ref_mouse.rnaseq"
metadata <- seurat_integrated@meta.data
c <- as.data.frame(table(metadata$type.clustify, metadata$integrated_snn_res.2.2))

names(c) <- c("ref_mouse.rnaseq", "cluster2.2", "n")

c
```

```{r}
#ref_moca_main	Mus musculus	Mouse Organogenesis Cell Atlas (main cell types)

seurat_integrated <- clustify(
  input = seurat_integrated,
  cluster_col = "integrated_snn_res.2.2",
  ref_mat = ref_moca_main,
  seurat_out = TRUE
)

metadata <- seurat_integrated@meta.data
names(metadata)[names(metadata)=="type.clustify.clustify"] <- "clustiyr.ref_moca_main"

b <- as.data.frame(table(metadata$type.clustify.clustify, metadata$integrated_snn_res.2.2))
names(b) <- c("ref_moca_main", "cluster2.2", "n")

b

```{r}
types <- inner_join(a,b,  by=c("cluster2.2", "n"))
types2 <- inner_join(c,d, by=c("cluster2.2", "n"))
types3 <- inner_join(e,f, by=c("cluster2.2", "n"))
cell.types <- inner_join(types, types2, by=c("cluster2.2", "n"))
cell.types <- inner_join(cell.types, types3, by=c("cluster2.2", "n"))

cell.types <- cell.types  %>%  group_by(cluster2.2) %>% dplyr::filter(n!="0")

write.csv(cell.types, "results/Analysis_V1/cell_type_prediction_clustifyR.csv")

```

library(clustifyr)
library(usethis)
library(SingleR)
ref_mouse.rnaseq <- average_clusters(
  SingleR::mouse.rnaseq$data,
  SingleR::mouse.rnaseq$types,
  if_log = F
)

d1 <- c(
    paste0("[", "ref_MCA", "](", "https://github.com/rnabioco/clustifyrdata/raw/main/data/ref_MCA.rda", ")"),
    "Mouse Cell Atlas",
    dim(clustifyrdata::ref_MCA)[2],
    dim(clustifyrdata::ref_MCA)[1],
    "mouse",
    paste0("[from](", "https://www.cell.com/cell/fulltext/S0092-8674(18)30116-8", ")")
)

usethis::use_data(ref_mouse.rnaseq, compress = "xz", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
n_cells2 <- FetchData(seurat_integrated, 
                     vars = c("ident", "sample")) %>% 
        dplyr::count(ident,  sample)

n_cell.p <- n_cells2 %>% group_by(ident) %>% summarize(total_count = sum(n))

df <- left_join(n_cells2 , n_cell.p,  by = "ident") %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / total_count)



 

write.csv(df, "results/Analysis_V1/number_cells_sampleOnly_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
